task: T2: add the two overrides to scripts/ralph-build.sh — the mechanism a "retry from here" control needs. `RALPH_FORCE_FROM` holds a 1-based task index: task with that index and every task after it must run even when their gates already pass, while tasks before it may still be skipped. `RALPH_FORCE_ALL=1` disables skipping entirely, for a human who wants the work redone from scratch regardless of gate state. Neither variable set means the T2 behaviour is unchanged. Treat an unset or empty value as absent, and a value that is not a positive integer as absent rather than as zero — a malformed override that silently means "force everything" would surprise, and one that silently means "force nothing" would be worse. Announce at the start of the run when either override is in effect and what it will do, because an operator who set the variable in a previous shell needs to see that it is still acting. These are the only two knobs this task adds; do not add a polled control source, which needs a coordinator and belongs to its own spec.
